text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-senpai, hello~!
Is the cafe bustling with busi—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Wait! Wh-What's wrong?! You've got the exact face you make before pool training—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: D-D-Dantsu-chan! Help meeeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Due to a shift mix-up, we're short on hall staff~... I'm assigned to kitchen duty...
I'm so sorry to ask on such short notice, but...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's totally fine, I'll help out!
I'll do my best with customer service...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! The café's concept is
'Serving you in all kinds of outfits!'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So Dantsu-chan, take the audience to a wonderful world
with all kinds of different outfits!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Shortish Hair
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A café in a place like this?
Looks pretty empty, maybe I'll check it out?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W... Welcome.
Milady!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Shortish Hair
text_block_list.text:
D-Dants-san?! Waaah!!
Are you a butler? It suits you so well...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ...Thank you very much.
U-Um, I will take care of you with all my heart, Milady.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Shortish Hair
text_block_list.text: ...S-So cuuuute!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That slightly clumsy vibe was the best!" ...they said!
Butler-style Dantsu-chan is a massive hit~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness! That feeling just now, right?
I think I'm starting to get it, just a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Let's try something a bit more daring for the next outfit~!

text_block_list.name: Long Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This is the place that was trending a bit on social media, right?
The cafe that's "so soothing to visit"...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh―― My.
You over there, come this way.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There, there. Big sis knows.
You're always working hard at training, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still, pushing yourself too hard is... a no-no.
How about we take it nice and easy today?”

text_block_list.name: Long Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: D-Dants-onesama... ♡

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Nice, nice~!
I totally knew a much more mature outfit
would look great on you~♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, aren't you enjoying this too, Mirako-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, sorry, sorry.
You just have a different vibe than usual, Dantsu-chan,
so it got me all excited.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Still, next up is Dantsu-chan's main event!
It's a super special concept!

Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival.
Having heard that Dants Flame was helping out at a stall, I went to check on her, and—
A long line had formed in front of the shop where she works.
choice_data_list: There's quite a huge crowd gathering...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!!
...U-Um—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Your idol—
Dants Flame is here♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! How is it?!
I-Is it cute?! It is, right?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's not!! It's cute, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's right! I am the world's cutest Umamusume idol! Dantsu Flame—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... What in the world
am I saying to my Trainer~?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-I was just serving customers with the concept of a high-self-esteem idol right now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But I'm just so clumsy at it...!
And my face gets all hot right away... Uuuu~...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it surprisingly seems to have a good reputation—

I look at the line in front of the store again.
Thanks to her explanation, I now understand why it's so long.
choice_data_list: You're really bringing energy to everyone.
You're really bringing energy to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer!
I'm going to try even harder at being an idol!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"The secret to capturing everyone's hearts...
I feel like what I need to become the star
might just be right here...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Dantsu-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! Everything in the shop is completely sold out!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your lovely customer service, Dantsu-chan!
Thank you so, so much~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
!? N-No, cute, not at all!
It's only thanks to everyone's cooking...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Don't be shy, don't be shy~.
I was watching you the entire time I was serving food~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Seriously, it was suuuper cute~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! ...Urrrgh, Mirako-senpai!
Come on, that's enough already...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! Everything in the shop is completely sold out!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not all!
The huge line of people in front of the store—
they said they came to see Idol Dantsu-chan!

Judging from Hishi Miracle's words,
every single person lined up here
came to see Dantsu Flame.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...!
All this... just for me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall correctly, an online article mentioned this.
In times like this—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for coming today!
Umm...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... so that everyone will remember me,
I'd like to share my catchphrase!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Ring-ring-ring right into your heart♪ Everyone's leading star, Dantsu Flame♪"

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOOO!!!!
RING-RING-RIIIIIIIIIING!!!!"

And so, Dantsu Flame continued greeting
and interacting with fans right up until
the Fan Thanksgiving festival ended.
